round2_post_modifications.description: 4 additional modifications approved after Round 2 scoring, applied to reading_guide.md for Round 3
modifications: 婚恋极性特别规则: Two-step method (intensity → direction); fallback: 方向待定 defaults to '关系高度活跃期' not TURBULENT
置信度上限规则: Romance capped at Med-High, Health capped at Medium; HIGH requires all 3 systems agree
健康预测附加条件: Must specify specific health direction, not generic; others' health excluded from person's dimension
五行缺失的大运/流年补充判定: Missing element + luck period supplement ≠ functional deficit
